import ast, io, json, logging, secrets, socket, sys, types
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd() / 'docs/evaluations'))
from dotenv import dotenv_values
from env001_example_contract import EXAMPLE, isolated_settings, load_example, source_fields
from env002_bootstrap_contract import source_namespace
from sqlmodel import Session, SQLModel, col, create_engine, select
checks=[]
_, fields=source_fields()
values=dotenv_values(EXAMPLE, interpolate=False)
assert set(values)==set(fields) and len(fields)==len(values)
checks.append('deployer_all_source_fields_have_exactly_one_example_key')
password_keys=['INITIAL_ADMIN_PASSWORD','INITIAL_SYSTEM_PASSWORD','INITIAL_CULTURE_PASSWORD']
cls=isolated_settings()
with patch.dict('os.environ',{},clear=True):
    defaults=cls(_env_file=None)
    loaded=load_example(EXAMPLE)
assert all(getattr(defaults,k)==getattr(loaded,k)==values[k]=='' for k in password_keys)
checks.append('deployer_example_and_source_have_no_login_password_for_any_builtin_account')
ns,_=source_namespace()
user, tenant, membership=[ns[k] for k in ('User','Tenant','Membership')]
stream=io.StringIO(); handler=logging.StreamHandler(stream); logger=ns['logger']
logger.disabled=False; logger.setLevel(logging.INFO); logger.addHandler(handler)
roles={'admin':('system_admin',False,'member'),'system':('tenant_admin',False,'tenant_admin'),'culture':('member',True,'member')}
all_secrets=[]; all_hashes=[]
with patch.object(socket.socket,'connect',side_effect=AssertionError('network_forbidden')):
    for bits in range(16):
        passwords={name:secrets.token_urlsafe(24) if bits & (1<<i) else '' for i,name in enumerate(('admin','system','culture'))}
        all_secrets.extend(p for p in passwords.values() if p)
        username='admin' if bits & 8 else ''
        ns['settings']=types.SimpleNamespace(INITIAL_ADMIN_USERNAME=username,INITIAL_ADMIN_EMAIL='',
            INITIAL_ADMIN_PASSWORD=passwords['admin'],INITIAL_SYSTEM_PASSWORD=passwords['system'],INITIAL_CULTURE_PASSWORD=passwords['culture'])
        triple=bool(passwords['system'] or passwords['culture'])
        reject=triple and not (username and all(passwords.values()))
        engine=create_engine('sqlite://')
        SQLModel.metadata.create_all(engine)
        with Session(engine) as session:
            try:
                ns['ensure_initial_admin'](session)
            except ValueError:
                assert reject
            else:
                assert not reject
            rows=session.exec(select(user)).all()
            count=3 if triple and not reject else (1 if not triple and username and passwords['admin'] else 0)
            assert len(rows)==count
            assert len(session.exec(select(membership)).all())==count
            assert len(session.exec(select(tenant)).all())==bool(count)
            for row in rows:
                role,is_test,member_role=roles[row.username]
                assert (row.role,row.is_test_user,row.must_change_password)==(role,is_test,True)
                assert ns['verify_password'](passwords[row.username],row.hashed_password)
                binding=session.exec(select(membership).where(col(membership.user_id)==row.id)).one()
                assert binding.tenant_id==row.tenant_id and binding.role==member_role
                all_hashes.append(row.hashed_password)
            snapshot={row.id:row.hashed_password for row in rows}
            if not reject:
                ns['ensure_initial_admin'](session)
                assert {row.id:row.hashed_password for row in session.exec(select(user)).all()}==snapshot
        engine.dispose()
assert all(secret not in stream.getvalue() for secret in all_secrets+all_hashes)
logger.removeHandler(handler)
checks.extend(['all_16_username_and_three_password_presence_combinations_match_documented_behavior',
               'missing_triple_inputs_leave_no_user_tenant_or_membership_rows',
               'single_and_triple_accounts_have_expected_roles_flags_memberships_and_real_bcrypt',
               'repeated_bootstrap_preserves_ids_and_hashes',
               'bootstrap_logs_exclude_generated_secrets_and_password_hashes',
               'business_acceptance_network_connections_forbidden'])
print(json.dumps({'checks':checks,'result':'pass','presence_combinations':16,'field_count':len(fields)},ensure_ascii=False))
